name: Weber-Fechner Law
description: Synthetic experiment runner implementing the Weber-Fechner psychophysical law relating physical stimulus intensity to perceived sensation.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Number of allowed values for stimulus intensities.

parameters.name: constant
parameters.description: Constant multiplier in the Weber-Fechner formula.

parameters.name: maximum_stimulus_intensity
parameters.description: Maximum value for stimulus intensities S1 and S2.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame with two stimulus intensities (S1, S2) as independent variables.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: DataFrame with detected difference in sensation as dependent variable.
